questions.explanation: Two dimensions each scale by k, so area scales by k^2. A single dimension would scale linearly.

questions.topic: An area from a scale factor
questions.stem: Memo 27: 15 m^2 lot scaled by factor 2; find new area.
questions.explanation: New area = 15*2^2 = 60. The linear factor is squared for area.

questions.topic: An inscribed circle and a square
questions.stem: Memo 54: square side 10 m; find inscribed circle radius.
questions.explanation: Radius = side/2 = 5. The diameter equals the side for an inscribed circle.

questions.topic: A circumscribed circle and a square
questions.stem: Memo 1 asks which expression gives circumradius of a square side s.

options.text: s divided by 2
s times square root of 2
s squared divided by 2
s times square root of 2 divided by 2

questions.explanation: The circumradius is half the diagonal: s*sqrt(2)/2. The inradius is half the side.
